How to Play Pinwheel Spin{KP}It's a pinwheel puzzle!{KP}Line up 3 pinwheels of the same color, and they disappear!{KP}Pinwheels inside the square frame swap colors with the Circle button!{KP}Use the Triangle button to switch the square frame between vertical and horizontal!{KP}If you think you made a mistake, press the X button to try again!{KP}You can go back to where you were one move earlier!{KP}Single-player has no time limit, so think it all through and clear every pinwheel!
